construction:bill_of_quantities.definition: A document listing the measured quantities of each item of work, used for pricing.

construction:change_order.definition: A formal instruction that changes the contracted work, its price or its time (North American usage).

construction:client.definition: The party that commissions and pays for the works (the employer or project owner).

construction:daywork.definition: Work paid on the time, labour, plant and materials actually used, not at contract rates.

construction:defects_liability_period.definition: The period after completion during which the contractor must correct defects.

fr.text: Période de garantie de parfait achèvement

construction:drawing_revision.definition: A numbered or lettered version of a drawing that supersedes the earlier one.

construction:handover.definition: The formal transfer of the completed works to the client.

construction:main_contractor.definition: The contractor in a direct contract with the client to carry out the works.

construction:method_statement.definition: A document describing how a task will be carried out safely, step by step.

construction:practical_completion.definition: The stage at which the works are complete enough to be handed over and used.

construction:project.definition: A defined scope of construction work with its own budget, schedule and team.

construction:request_for_information.definition: A formal question from the contractor asking the design team to clarify information.

construction:risk_assessment.definition: A record of the hazards of a task, who might be harmed, and the controls in place.

construction:site.definition: The physical location where construction work is carried out.

construction:site_diary.definition: The daily record of work, labour, weather, deliveries and events on a site.

construction:site_instruction.definition: A written instruction issued on site by the client's representative.

construction:snag_list.definition: A list of defects or incomplete items to be put right before handover.

construction:subcontractor.definition: A company or person engaged by the main contractor to carry out part of the works.

construction:variation_order.definition: A formal instruction that changes the scope, quantity or quality of contracted work (UK and Commonwealth usage).

construction:work_package.definition: A defined portion of the works let or managed as one unit.

field:inspection.definition: A planned check of work, materials or conditions against requirements.

field:near_miss.definition: An unplanned event that did not cause harm but could have.

field:permit_to_work.definition: A written authorisation to carry out a specific high-risk task under stated controls.

field:ppe.definition: Personal protective equipment such as helmets, boots, gloves and high-visibility clothing.

field:toolbox_talk.definition: A short safety briefing given to the crew on site before work starts.

finance:advance_payment.definition: A payment made before the work it pays for, usually secured by a guarantee.

finance:final_account.definition: The agreed final statement of the total sum due under the contract.

finance:goods_received_note.definition: A record confirming the goods delivered against a purchase order.

finance:interim_valuation.definition: A periodic valuation of the work done to date, used for interim payments.

finance:invoice.definition: A supplier's or contractor's request for payment.

finance:liquidated_damages.definition: A pre-agreed sum the contractor pays for each period of delay.

finance:payment_certificate.definition: A document certifying the amount due to the contractor for a period.

finance:purchase_order.definition: A commercial document issued to a supplier to order goods or services at agreed prices.

finance:requisition.definition: An internal request to buy materials, plant or services.

finance:retention.definition: A percentage of each payment held back until completion and the end of the defects period.
